WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "all_star"."player_id" AS e, "player"."throws" AS g, COUNT(*) AS m1 FROM "all_star" JOIN "player" ON "player"."player_id" = "all_star"."player_id"  GROUP BY "all_star"."player_id", "player"."throws") SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, AVG("s1"."m1") AS m1 FROM "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g"

WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "appearances"."player_id" AS e, SUM("appearances"."g_all") AS m1, COUNT(*) AS m2 FROM "appearances" GROUP BY "appearances"."player_id"), "s2" AS (SELECT SUM("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1") SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT AVG("fielding_outfield"."grf") AS m1 FROM "fielding_outfield"

WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "batting"."player_id" AS e, "player"."death_country" AS g, AVG("batting"."so") AS m1, COUNT(*) AS m2 FROM "batting" JOIN "player" ON "player"."player_id" = "batting"."player_id"  GROUP BY "batting"."player_id", "player"."death_country"), "s2" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s1"."g" ORDER BY "s1"."m2" DESC) AS r FROM "s1") SELECT "s2"."e" AS e, "s2"."g" AS g, "s2"."m1" AS m1, "s2"."m2" AS m2, "s2"."r" AS r FROM "s2" WHERE "s2"."r" <= 3

SELECT "player_award"."player_id" AS e, "player"."death_country" AS g, COUNT(*) AS m1 FROM "player_award" JOIN "player" ON "player"."player_id" = "player_award"."player_id"  GROUP BY "player_award"."player_id", "player"."death_country" ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10

WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "manager"."team_id" AS e, SUM("manager"."w") AS m1, AVG((CAST("manager"."l" AS REAL) / "manager"."g")) AS m2 FROM "manager" GROUP BY "manager"."team_id"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1") SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10
